App runtime: the golden's only non-builtin requires are 'express' and 'better-sqlite3' (grep of solution/app; package.json pins express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1), both installed globally at the same versions in the verifier image with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, which test.sh passes to the unprivileged app. Agent image (environment/Dockerfile) installs exactly the same two npm packages, so runtime-deps parity holds; instruction.md:13 and integration.md:3-4 tell the agent to use only those packages and Node.
